description_en: Queries the real-time antivirus defense policy of the current Alibaba Cloud account
description_zh: 查询当前阿里云账号的防病毒实时防御策略
name: GetAntiVirusRealTimeDefenceStrategy

HighRiskOperation.description_en:
The action taken on high-risk virus files. Valid values:
Quarantine: Quarantines quarantined file.
Notify: Reports an alert only without taking action on quarantined file. Quarantine is returned if no real-time defense policy has been configured
HighRiskOperation.description_zh:
对高危病毒文件的处置动作。取值：
Quarantine：隔离文件。
Notify：仅上报告警，不处置文件。尚未配置过实时防御策略时返回Quarantine

LowRiskOperation.description_en:
The action taken on low-risk virus files. Valid values:
Quarantine: Quarantines quarantined file.
Notify: Reports an alert only without taking action on quarantined file.
None: Takes no action. None is returned if no real-time defense policy has been configured
LowRiskOperation.description_zh:
对低危病毒文件的处置动作。取值：
Quarantine：隔离文件。
Notify：仅上报告警，不处置文件。
None：不处理。尚未配置过实时防御策略时返回None

MatchMode.description_en:
The matching mode of the effective scope. Valid values:
UserGroupAll: Applies to all users under the current Alibaba Cloud account.
UserGroupNormal: Applies only to users in specified user groups. An empty string is returned if no real-time defense policy has been configured
MatchMode.description_zh:
生效范围的匹配方式。取值：
UserGroupAll：对当前阿里云账号下的全部用户生效。
UserGroupNormal：仅对指定用户组内的用户生效。尚未配置过实时防御策略时返回空字符串

MatchTargetIds.description_en: The collection of user group IDs to which the policy applies. An empty list is returned when MatchMode is set to UserGroupAll
MatchTargetIds.description_zh: 生效的用户组ID集合。MatchMode取值为UserGroupAll时返回空列表

MaxCpuUsage.description_en: The maximum percentage of endpoint CPU that real-time defense can use. The default value 30 is returned if a policy has been configured but this parameter is not separately set. 0 is returned if no real-time defense policy has been configured
MaxCpuUsage.description_zh: 实时防御占用终端CPU的百分比上限。已配置策略且未单独设置时返回默认值30。尚未配置过实时防御策略时返回0

MidRiskOperation.description_en:
The action taken on medium-risk virus files. Valid values:
Quarantine: Quarantines quarantined file.
Notify: Reports an alert only without taking action on quarantined file. Notify is returned if no real-time defense policy has been configured
MidRiskOperation.description_zh:
对中危病毒文件的处置动作。取值：
Quarantine：隔离文件。
Notify：仅上报告警，不处置文件。尚未配置过实时防御策略时返回Notify

ScanTargets.description_en: The collection of virus types that the real-time defense handles. An empty list is returned if no real-time defense policy has been configured
ScanTargets.description_zh: 实时防御要处置的病毒类型集合。尚未配置过实时防御策略时返回空列表

Status.description_en:
The enabling status. Valid values:
Enabled: Enabled.
Disabled: Disabled. Disabled is returned if no real-time defense policy has been configured
Status.description_zh:
启用状态。取值：
Enabled：已启用。
Disabled：已停用。尚未配置过实时防御策略时返回Disabled

StrategyId.description_en: The ID of the real-time defense policy. An empty string is returned if no real-time defense policy has been configured
StrategyId.description_zh: 实时防御策略ID。尚未配置过实时防御策略时返回空字符串

Whitelist.description_en: The list of exempted usernames. Users in this list are not subject to real-time defense. An empty list is returned if no exemption is configured
Whitelist.description_zh: 例外用户名单，名单内的用户不启用实时防御。未配置时返回空列表
